notes: Latitude is planetocentric, longitude is east-positive in 0-360 degrees. 'approximate': true means the coordinate is the centre of a region, not a specific landing point. Surface heights are not stored here; they are read from the LOLA terrain.

sites.name: IM-2 Athena landing site (Mons Mouton)
sites.coordinate_basis: Position of the Athena lander located in LROC NAC images after the 6 March 2025 landing (CLPS IM-2).

sites.name: Apollo 11 Lunar Module (Tranquility Base)
sites.coordinate_basis: Lunar Module position from LRO images (Wagner et al., 2017, Icarus 283, 92-103), Mean Earth/Polar Axis system, DE421.
